env.name: purifier-basic-tests-1.2.3
env.postInstall:
missing=0
while IFS= read -r file; do
  if [ ! -e "$out/$file" ] && [ ! -L "$out/$file" ]; then
    echo "cmake-purifier: the lockfile names the output $file, which the install did not write. Run \`cmake-purifier lock\` again." >&2
    missing=1
  fi
done < "$lockedOutputsPath"
[ "$missing" = 0 ]
env.preCheck: unset http_proxy https_proxy HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY no_proxy NO_PROXY
env.preConfigure:
# mitm-cache is the proxy of the whole build, the tests included.
# Requests to the machine itself, such as a test's own server, are
# no downloads, and go around it.
export no_proxy="localhost,127.0.0.1,::1" NO_PROXY="localhost,127.0.0.1,::1"
if [ "$(bash /nix/store/ajq0xiyhr4bc55bck0mgcw1v553hhjrv-definition-hash.sh .)" != a840dee298081d47140abc96a2539a0679d5afcc7bf78a96add402acfe45ea8a ]; then
  echo "cmake-purifier: /nix/store/b7nkmhhn4nsag6533sqps9sznwglj7cy-source/tests/fixtures/basic/cmake-purifier.lock.json is older than the project: a CMakeLists.txt or *.cmake file changed since it was written. Run \`cmake-purifier lock\` to lock the project again." >&2
  exit 1
fi
